resources.string: Share one keyboard and mouse with your phone.
Point the camera at the QR shown on the Windows app. No IP or pairing code needed.
MVP limits: pointer taps and swipes need the accessibility service. Typing works in text fields when the InputBridge keyboard is selected. No encryption: use a trusted local network.
InputBridge uses this service only to dispatch taps, swipes and limited navigation actions requested by the paired laptop while Phone mode is active.
